title: Subscription billing for a fitness SaaS
problem: Gym owners collected memberships manually by bank transfer.
approach: Built plans, trials, proration and dunning emails with webhooks and an admin dashboard.
result: 1,400 paying members migrated in two weeks; failed-payment recovery 38%.

title: Real-time logistics tracking dashboard
problem: Dispatchers phoned drivers to ask where they were.
approach: Live map with driver positions pushed from a Node service, plus ETA alerts.
result: Dispatcher calls dropped 60%; 300 concurrent drivers on a $40/month server.

title: Marketplace MVP for handmade goods
problem: Founders needed a working two-sided marketplace for a pilot in six weeks.
approach: Seller onboarding, listings, cart, split payouts and Google sign-in.
result: Launched in 5.5 weeks; 120 sellers and $18k GMV in the first month.

title: GraphQL API for a news app
problem: Mobile and web clients made 14 REST calls to render one screen.
approach: Single GraphQL schema with dataloaders and per-field caching.
result: Home-screen load time from 3.2 s to 0.9 s; backend costs down 30%.

title: Shopify inventory sync app
problem: Overselling happened because a warehouse system and Shopify disagreed.
approach: Custom app that reconciles stock every minute with a queue and conflict rules.

title: Clinic appointment booking platform
problem: Receptionists double-booked doctors using a shared spreadsheet.
approach: Booking flows with availability rules, SMS reminders and an audit log.
result: No double bookings since launch; no-shows down 27% with reminders.

title: E2E test suite for a checkout
problem: Every release broke something in checkout.
approach: 120 end-to-end scenarios running in parallel on every pull request with visual diffs.
result: Checkout incidents after release fell from 6 per quarter to 0 over two quarters.

title: Serverless image pipeline
problem: Photographers waited minutes for previews to appear.
approach: Event-driven resizing and watermarking on upload with CDN invalidation.
result: Preview latency under 2 s at p95; infra bill $11/month for 200k images.

title: Internal CRM on Django
problem: Agents tracked leads in personal notebooks.
approach: Lead pipeline, role-based admin, CSV import and weekly reports.
result: Lead response time halved; adopted by all 35 agents.

title: Cross-platform fitness companion app
problem: Members wanted to book classes from their phones.
approach: iOS/Android app sharing 90% code, with social login and push notifications.
result: 4.7-star rating; 60% of bookings moved to mobile in two months.

title: Multi-tenant SaaS starter
problem: I kept rebuilding the same auth/billing/tenancy boilerplate for clients.
approach: Open-source starter with row-level tenancy, invites, billing and audit logs.
result: 210 GitHub stars; reused in 4 client projects to save ~3 weeks each.

title: Legacy jQuery to React migration
problem: A 9-year-old quoting UI was impossible to change safely.
approach: Incremental strangler migration screen by screen behind feature flags.
result: Migrated 42 screens with zero downtime; bug reports down 55%.

title: Event ticketing with QR check-in
problem: Paper tickets caused long queues and fraud at festivals.
approach: Ticket sales, signed QR codes and an offline-tolerant scanner app.
result: Scanned 9,000 attendees in 90 minutes; zero duplicate entries.

title: Headless CMS website with i18n
problem: A school network needed one site in English, Urdu and Arabic.
approach: Static-first site with RTL support, CMS previews and image optimisation.
result: Lighthouse 98; organic traffic up 70% in three months.

title: Background export service for a B2B portal
problem: Customers' monthly CSV exports timed out and support had to email files manually.
approach: Moved exports to queued background jobs with progress notifications and signed download links.
result: Export failures went from 15% to under 0.5%; support tickets about exports stopped.
